_about: Finder 27.2.1 (26B131) measured live on a 920x560 pt test window (test folder on a mounted test disk image). Points, window-relative (0,0 = window top-left). Colours sRGB from 2x window captures (-o). Wallpaper Electric Blue unless noted. a = active/key, i = inactive.

search.expanded: ~241x36 capsule, view switcher collapses to a 51pt popup

toolbar.glyphs: 13 pt .large .medium SF Symbols (R3b-3); ink: chevron 8x14, grid 15.5, list 16.5x12, columns 19.5x15, gallery 19x14.5, search 16x16.5, ellipsis 15x3

dark.strip: 32,33,39 (39,41,47 while the pointer is in the toolbar or the window is inactive)

toolbar.hover: inner capsule 28 tall (y 12..40), 30 wide on back/forward/action, 35.5 on view segments, whole circle on search; divider hides; disabled buttons: none
toolbar.pressed: same as hover at 80 ms; holding back/forward ~0.3 s opens the history menu

sidebar.headerHover: chevron.down ink 9.5x5.5 at x 136.5..146, centred on the header row, dark 160,162,177 (secondary); no row fill

iconView.viewOptions: icon size slider 24 (=64 pt), grid spacing 54, text size 12, labels Bottom

label.truncation: middle ellipsis on the last line

selection.label: pill 17 tall (1 line), r5, padding ~5 left

iconView.tagDots: 10 pt circles left of the name inside the label, each extra tag offset +5 pt behind the previous, 0.5 pt white separator ring, ~3 pt to text

header.font: SF 11; sorted column Semibold label colour (76 light / 255 dark), others Regular secondary (127)
header.fill: light 255 (same as content), dark 40,40,46 bar incl. the toolbar strip
header.sortChevron: 7.5x5 at 6.5 pt left of the column edge
header.resizeCursor: 30x24 hot (15,12) within ~1 pt of the boundary

listView.font: SF 13 Regular; name label, other columns secondary (128)

columnView.grip: none; resize cursor over the divider
columnView.preview: ~240 pt column: QL preview 219x259, name 13 bold, kind 11, Information + Created/Modified/Last opened rows 23 pt, Tags editor, Markup/More buttons

galleryView.selectedThumb: plate 54x54 r7, light 189 / dark 87,88,92, unchanged when inactive
galleryView.pane: ~240-250 pt, same material as the sidebar (light 237 / dark 36,38,55), icon 50, name 15 Semibold, kind 13 Regular tertiary, headings 13 Semibold, meta rows 11 (label secondary, value Medium), 'Show More' 11 accent, Rotate/Markup/More buttons at the bottom

statusBar.position: below the path bar (window grows by 28)
statusBar.text: centred, '9 items, 112,1 MB' / '1 of 9 selected, ...', ~11 pt secondary (128)
statusBar.extra: icon-size slider 82x16 at the right in icon view

tabs.selectedTab: 24 tall (2 pt inset), r12, light 253 / dark 61,61,69
tabs.font: SF 11 Regular; selected light 75 / dark 235, unselected light 181 / dark 132
tabs.hover: unselected tab darkens (light 220 / dark 66,66,73) and shows an x close glyph at its left (AX 18x18 at tab x+4)
tabs.newTab: + circle ~30 pt at x 883.5..912, light fill 249 rim 191
tabs.inactive: selected tab light 240 / dark 51,51,60 on the same track, text dim

renameField.icon: field 74x14 at the label, white, text 12, 3 pt focus ring accent a~0.5 (light 149,179,246) with a 0.5 pt darker inner edge (114,158,244), outer radius ~5
renameField.list: field 16 tall inside the selected row, same ring (spills over the row)

drag.multiBadge: 19 pt red circle (231,74,64), white bold count, at the icon's bottom-right
drag.iconTarget: grey plate 226 r~8 (like the selection plate)
drag.listTarget: no row highlight seen within 0.7 s
drag.springLoad: folder opens in place <1.9 s; Esc reverts

quickLook.window: separate floating panel (layer 3) 1463x951 for a 1600x1000 image, centred
quickLook.controls: close + full-screen 14 pt discs at (11,12),(31,12); title 13 bold; Markup/Rotate/Share 34x26; 'Open with Preview' capsule 139x26
quickLook.open: appears at ~0.79 scale centred, grows to 1.0 in ~0.25 s ease-out, no fade seen
quickLook.close: shrinks/moves into the file's icon in ~0.18 s

contextMenus.notes: * only with something on the clipboard. No tag row: this account has no favourite tags (FavoriteTagNames = ('')). Icons on Move to Bin, Share, Customise Folder, Quick Actions, Services.

motion.viewSwitch: content and selected pill change in 1 frame (no slide)
motion.searchExpand: ~0.15-0.17 s ease-out width change; view switcher collapses to a popup in 1 frame; focus ring appears at the end
motion.toolbarStripReveal: dark: strip lightens while the pointer is in the toolbar
